claims.claim: Original copies, not photocopies or local reprints.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show book spines/titles but do not show publisher pages, ISBNs, or print/edition details needed to confirm originality.
Photos only show spines/covers; no interior pages are shown to confirm absence of writing/highlighting.

claims.claim: Get 5 copies of good books for 20k & 10 copies for 33k.
claims.evidence: Witness did not report the exact number of books in the set or whether the seller can supply exactly 5 or 10 copies from the same bundle.
This is a slogan and not verifiable from the witness photos.

risks.risk: Exact count mismatch (photos don’t confirm how many books are in the bundle), which affects whether you can buy the intended quantity (5 vs 10).
risks.proof: A wide shot showing the full stack/bundle with the total number of books visible (or a count on camera).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a smaller/uncertain quantity bundle; treat as worst-case for quantity availability.

risks.risk: Condition risk: possible spine cracks, loose binding, heavy stains, or water damage not visible from spine-only photos.
risks.proof: A close-up of bindings/spine cracks plus a photo of the page edges and a flat-open shot showing the gutter/binding condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with potential binding issues (worst-case minor damage).

risks.risk: Completeness risk: missing pages/chapters or torn pages not visible from spines.
risks.proof: A photo of several randomly selected interior pages (including near the beginning, middle, and end) showing intact pages.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete/needs checking; worst-case treat as not guaranteed complete.

risks.risk: Interior markings risk (writing/highlighting) not visible from spines.
risks.proof: A clear photo of open pages showing margins/notes/highlights (at least 2–3 different books).

risks.risk: Originality risk: could be reprints/unauthorized editions; spines alone may not confirm.
risks.proof: Photos of the copyright/publisher page and ISBN page for at least 2 books.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used books without confirmed originality.

proof_requests: Show a wide shot of the entire bundle with the total number of books clearly visible (so we can confirm 5 vs 10).
Provide photos of the bindings: spine close-ups (cracks/loose binding) and page-edge condition.
Open 2–3 books flat and photograph random interior pages (beginning/middle/end) to confirm completeness and no torn pages.
Photograph open pages to confirm whether there is any writing/highlighting inside.
For originality: photograph the copyright/publisher page and ISBN page for at least 2 titles.
response.reason: The witness report consistently identifies a set of business/self-help books in generally good used condition based on spine/covers, so a worst-case used-book valuation is possible; however, originality, interior writing, completeness, and exact count remain unverified and should be priced conservatively until proven.
